evidence.summary: On Sept 23, 2025 Testkube announced an $8M Series A led by existing investors Ratmir Timashev, co-founder of Veeam, and global software investor Insight Partners. Testkube is a NYC-based, Kubernetes-native continuous testing platform (a 2023 Kubeshop spin-off) that has powered 100M+ automated tests for customers including Cloudflare, Siemens, Adobe and Volvo. Insight's Mike Triplett is quoted as Managing Director. No per-investor cheque, stage tranche, or round amount split was disclosed.
